AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

3.
Approval and Transfer of Projected Property Taxes Collected Through Measure E into the General Fund
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council "transfer in" the projected property taxes collected through Measure E into the City's General Fund for Palos Verdes Estates Police Department expenditures.
Staff Report
4.
Consideration for the Finance Advisory Committee to Meet Within the First Two Weeks of the Month instead of Meeting on Every Fourth Thursday of the Month
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council authorize the Finance Advisory Committee (FAC) to meet within the first two weeks of the month instead of meeting on every fourth Thursday of the month; with the day and week to be determined at the FAC meeting on July 25, 2019.
Staff Report
5.
Planning Commission Actions of 6/18/19
Recommendation: Recommendation: Receive & File
Staff Report
6.
Traffic Analysis for the Intersection of Palos Verdes Drive North and Via Valmonte
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council direct staff to complete the review of the project DEIR and TIS and provide those comments to the City of Torrance within the public comment period.
Staff Report
7.
Approval of a One-Time Suspension of the Palos Verdes Golf Club Fund Transfer Between the Operating and Capital Improvement Funds
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve a one-time suspension of Palos Verdes Golf Club (PVGC) fund transfers between the Operating and Capital Improvement Fund (CIF) of $400,000.
Staff Report
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
OLD BUSINESS
8.
Consideration of Policy for Public Use of the City's Council Chambers
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider the proposed Chambers Use Policy.
Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
9.
Consideration for the Creation of the Palos Verdes Estates Pension Ad Hoc Committee and Public Safety Ad Hoc Committee, the Appointments of City Councilmembers to These Committees and Updating the Committee List
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council establish the Pension and Public Safety Ad Hoc Committees, appoint City Council members to serve on these bodies, and approve the updated Committee List, inclusive of descriptions of these two new bodies, as well as the descriptions of the Butcher Solano Project and Palos Verdes Estates Foundations Ad Hoc Committees.
Staff Report
10.
Consideration and Possible Action to Amend the Municipal Code to Change the Starting Time of City Council Regular Meetings
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council direct staff to prepare an ordinance to amend the Municipal Code for the City Council's consideration.
Staff Report
11.
Discussion and Consideration of Filling Vacancies
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council authorize the Interim City Manager to proceed with filling the four vacancies.
Staff Report
12.
Review of Administrative Fines & Penalties for Short-Term Rental Violations
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve adopting administrative fines related to short-term rental violations at $2,500 upon first violation, $5,000 upon second violation, and $7,500 upon third violation within one year and direct staff to return to City Council with a resolution adopting a second tier of fines for short-term rentals.
Staff Report
13.
Afternoon Traffic Control Officer at PV Drive W/Via Corta
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council decline to proceed with additional manual traffic control at this time until after the preliminary results of the PVDW corridor feasibility study are presented as recommended by the TSC.
Staff Report
STAFF REPORTS
i.
City Manager's Report
MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS
ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, JULY 23, 2019, AT 6:00 P.M. IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS OF CITY HALL FOR THE PURPOSE OF A CLOSED SESSION.
